name: setup-code
description: nadesh00's Claude Code mods: prompt enhancement, a live subagent panel with /boost, and a past-conversations picker

plugins.name: prompt-enhance
plugins.description: End a prompt with " ++" to have it rewritten into a sharper prompt in the prompt bar instead of sent

plugins.name: session-boost
plugins.description: /subagents: a live side panel of every subagent with cheaper-model suggestions; /boost: a watcher that launches read-only helper subagents for the turn in progress

plugins.name: conversations
plugins.description: /conversations: this project's past conversations by meaningful title; click one to resume it
